description: Gradium's Phonon text-to-speech: a small flow-matching language model with a Mimi decoder, a descendant of Kyutai's pocket-tts, for real-time local synthesis on CPU and GPU with prepared voices.

request.name: frames_after_eos
request.description: Frames kept after EOS, counting the EOS frame; -1 keeps 4 for texts of up to four words and 2 otherwise, as the reference does.

request.name: max_frames
request.description: Maximum generated audio frames; zero estimates the cap from text length. Captured during session preparation.

request.name: text_chunk_tokens
request.description: Tokenizer tokens per text chunk; must be positive, default 50. Set during preparation and overridable per request.

request.name: temperature
request.description: Positive flow noise temperature. Captured during session preparation.

request.name: seed
request.description: Noise seed; omitted chooses a random seed. Captured during session preparation.

request.name: noise_clamp
request.description: Noise clamp; a negative value disables clamping. Captured during session preparation.

request.name: eos_threshold
request.description: EOS detection threshold on the EOS logit. Captured during session preparation.

request.name: noise_file
request.description: Precomputed noise schedule, raw float32 [frames, 32], used as given. Captured during session preparation.

request.name: voice_embedding_file
request.description: Voice file: a speaker_wavs latent file such as those of gradium/phonon-voices, or an exported voice state. Captured during session preparation.

request.name: text_chunk_size
request.description: Optional per-request character chunk size; otherwise use sentence/token budgeting.

request.name: export_voice_state_file
request.description: Export the prepared voice state during session preparation.

session.name: voice_state_cache_slots
session.description: Cached prepared voice states; zero disables reuse.

session.name: offline_graph_capacity_mode
session.description: Offline graph capacity policy; CPU/Metal default tiered, other backends double.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: Shared matmul weight storage; component matmul settings inherit it. Convolution storage remains independently native unless overridden.

session.name: matmul_weight_type
session.description: Weight storage type; component-specific settings inherit weight_type.

session.name: weight_context_mb
session.description: Context or graph arena size in MiB.

session.name: flow_weight_context_mb
session.description: Flow weight context in MiB; inherits gradium_phonon.weight_context_mb when omitted.

session.name: mimi_decoder_weight_context_mb
session.description: Mimi decoder weight context in MiB; inherits gradium_phonon.weight_context_mb when omitted.

session.name: flow_weights_view_context_mb
session.description: Context or graph arena size in MiB.

session.name: flow_step_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Flow-step host graph-metadata arena size in MiB, not device workspace.

session.name: mimi_conv_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Mimi convolution host graph-metadata arena size in MiB, not device workspace.

session.name: mimi_transformer_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Mimi transformer host graph-metadata arena size in MiB, not device workspace.

session.name: mimi_tail_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Mimi tail host graph-metadata arena size in MiB, not device workspace.

description.en: Gradium's Phonon text-to-speech: a small flow-matching language model with a Mimi decoder, a descendant of Kyutai's pocket-tts, for real-time local synthesis on CPU and GPU with prepared voices.
description.zh: Gradium Phonon 文本转语音：小型流匹配语言模型 + Mimi 解码器，源自 Kyutai pocket-tts，可在 CPU/GPU 上使用预置音色进行本地实时合成。

frames_after_eos.en: Frames kept after EOS, counting the EOS frame; -1 keeps 4 for texts of up to four words and 2 otherwise, as the reference does.
frames_after_eos.zh: EOS 之后保留的帧数（包含 EOS 帧）；-1 时，四个词以内的文本保留 4 帧，否则保留 2 帧，与参考实现一致。

max_frames.en: Maximum generated audio frames; zero estimates the cap from text length. Captured during session preparation.
max_frames.zh: 生成音频帧上限；0 表示按文本长度估算上限。在会话准备阶段捕获。

text_chunk_tokens.en: Tokenizer tokens per text chunk; must be positive, default 50. Set during preparation and overridable per request.
text_chunk_tokens.zh: 每个文本分块的 tokenizer token 数；必须为正，默认 50。准备阶段设置，可被单次请求覆盖。

temperature.en: Positive flow noise temperature. Captured during session preparation.
temperature.zh: 流噪声温度，必须为正。在会话准备阶段捕获。

seed.en: Noise seed; omitted chooses a random seed. Captured during session preparation.
seed.zh: 噪声随机种子；省略时随机选择。在会话准备阶段捕获。

noise_clamp.en: Noise clamp; a negative value disables clamping. Captured during session preparation.
noise_clamp.zh: 噪声裁剪值；负值关闭裁剪。在会话准备阶段捕获。

eos_threshold.en: EOS detection threshold on the EOS logit. Captured during session preparation.
eos_threshold.zh: EOS logit 的结束检测阈值。在会话准备阶段捕获。

noise_file.en: Precomputed noise schedule, raw float32 [frames, 32], used as given. Captured during session preparation.
noise_file.zh: 预计算噪声序列，raw float32 [frames, 32]，按原样使用。在会话准备阶段捕获。

voice_embedding_file.en: Voice file: a speaker_wavs latent file such as those of gradium/phonon-voices, or an exported voice state. Captured during session preparation.
voice_embedding_file.zh: 音色文件：speaker_wavs latent 文件（如 gradium/phonon-voices）或导出的 voice state。在会话准备阶段捕获。

text_chunk_size.en: Optional per-request character chunk size; otherwise use sentence/token budgeting.
text_chunk_size.zh: 可选的单请求字符分块大小；否则使用句子/token 预算。

export_voice_state_file.en: Export the prepared voice state during session preparation.
export_voice_state_file.zh: 在会话准备阶段导出已准备的 voice state。
